tasks.label: Build and requested checks
args: npm run build && node --check 7tv-multidonate.user.js && git diff --check

tasks.label: Build and validate Legion7TV bundle
args: npm run build && node --check 7tv-multidonate.user.js && git diff --check

tasks.label: Build and validate bundle
args: npm run build && node --check 7tv-multidonate.user.js && git diff --check && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('7tv-multidonate.user.js','utf8');for(const m of s.matchAll(/.{0,50}(?:resolved.{0,30}url|cache|clear).{0,70}/gi))console.log(m[0])"

tasks.label: Inspect bundle cache integration
args: const s=require('fs').readFileSync('7tv-multidonate.user.js','utf8'); for(const q of ['resolved','cache','clear']) { let i=-1; let n=0; while((i=s.toLowerCase().indexOf(q,i+1))>=0 && n<12) { console.log(q+': '+s.slice(Math.max(0,i-100),Math.min(s.length,i+180))); n++; } }

tasks.label: Verify built cache markers
args: const s=require("fs").readFileSync("7tv-multidonate.user.js","utf8"); for(const q of ["resolved","cache","clear"]) { let i=-1; let n=0; while((i=s.toLowerCase().indexOf(q,i+1))>=0 && n<12) { console.log(q+":"+s.slice(Math.max(0,i-100),Math.min(s.length,i+180))); n++; } }

tasks.label: Build Chromium extension
args: npm run build:chromium && node --check dist/chromium/content-bridge.js && node --check dist/chromium/page-bridge.js && node --check dist/chromium/background.js && git diff --check

tasks.label: Verify extension assets
args: const fs=require('node:fs');const sharp=require('sharp');const root='dist/chromium';Promise.all([16,32,48,128].map(async n=>{const p=root+'/icons/icon'+n+'.png';const m=await sharp(p).metadata();if(m.width!==n||m.height!==n)throw Error(p+': '+m.width+'x'+m.height);console.log(p+': '+m.width+'x'+m.height)})).then(()=>{const css=fs.statSync(root+'/styles.css').size;const js=fs.statSync(root+'/content-bridge.js').size;console.log('styles.css bytes:',css,'content-bridge.js bytes:',js,'manifest exists:',fs.existsSync(root+'/manifest.json'));if(css<1000||js<1000)throw Error('Missing/empty build output')}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})
